intro: I will ask you 6 short questions to find welfare schemes for you. Reply with the number of your answer. You can also type any question about a scheme at any time.
q_age: 3/6 How old are you? Type your age as a number.
q_income: 5/6 What is the total yearly income of your household?
invalid: Sorry, I did not understand. Please reply with a number from the options.
invalid_age: Please type your age as a number, for example 35.
result_none: I could not find a matching scheme. You can still ask me about any scheme.
result_hint: Reply with a number to see the documents and how to apply.
disclaimer: This is only guidance. The government decides final eligibility. Please verify on the official website.
docs_missing: The document list is not in my database. Please ask at the official office.
free_prompt: Ask me anything about welfare schemes. Answers come only from official scheme information, and I name the scheme.
translate_fail: Note: translation is not available right now, so this is shown in English.
s_pmkisan: Income support of ₹6,000 per year for farmer families who own land, paid in three instalments.
s_pmfby: Crop insurance that protects farmers from crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
s_kcc: A credit card for farmers to get loans for farming needs.
s_kmy: A monthly pension after age 60 for small and marginal farmers who join between ages 18 and 40.
s_pmjay: Free hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
s_pmuy: An LPG gas connection with government support for women from poor households.
s_pmayg: Money to build a pucca house for rural families who do not have one.
s_ssy: A savings account for your daughter's education and marriage, with government-set interest and tax benefits.
s_mgnrega: Up to 100 days of guaranteed paid work per year for rural households.
s_eshram: A free registration card for unorganised and gig workers, with accident insurance cover.
q_state: 2/6 Which state or union territory do you live in? Type its number.
invalid_state: I could not find that state. Please type the number from the list.
q_family: 6/6 Which of these applies to your family?
opt_family_nohouse: We do not have a pucca (concrete) house
opt_family_daughter: I have a daughter below 10 years of age
